turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Chris calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Cesar Fernandez?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Is this still the best number to reach you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, this is my cell.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Give me while I open your file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see the account here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $800.01.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly, I can't afford that amount. I'm going through a separation, so it's one income now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I just don't have the money right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To set that up I'll need a quick look at your monthly budget. What are your main fixed expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly rent, groceries and the car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team will follow up with the details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay 675 the 26th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $675.00 on August 26. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How would you like to that payment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Online banking is easiest.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any other questions for me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I think that's it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
